chunks: From him, from Ibn Mahbub, from Nuʿaym ibn Ibrahim, from ʿAbbad al-Basri, who said:

I asked Jaʿfar ibn Muhammad عليه السلام about three men who testified against a man for zina and said, “Now we will bring the fourth.” He said: So he replied, “All of them are to be flogged with the hadd of the slanderer: eighty lashes for each man among them.”

key_terms.ثَمَانِينَ: eighty, the number of lashes prescribed here
key_terms.جَلْدَةً: a lash or stripe in corporal punishment
key_terms.ٱلرَّابِعِ: the required fourth witness in the legal standard of proof
key_terms.ٱلزِّنَى: illicit sexual intercourse alleged in the testimony
key_terms.ٱلْقَاذِفِ: the one who makes a false accusation of zina without valid proof

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if only three witnesses testify to zina and say they will bring the fourth later?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding an incomplete accusation of zina. If only three witnesses testify and the required fourth witness is not present at the time of testimony, the three are punished with the hadd of qadhf, which is eighty lashes each.
